capacity_gross_kwh.notes: KBB (relaying Cadillac) lists 102.00 kWh on all trims; Wikipedia 102.0 kWh. Bare capacity treated as gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Same 102 kWh Ultium pack as the LYRIQ: Wikipedia lists 102 gross / 100 usable (Auto-data 100.4 net); ratio applied. Years 2026-2027.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Ultium NCMA cathode; closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Estimated from the GM Ultium platform: InsideEVs gives Ultium modules at about 288 V nominal (Equinox EV); the Vistiq 102 kWh pack is the same Ultium module family, 400 V class. No Vistiq page states the voltage.

dc_max_kw.notes: Charge Port and Wikipedia: DC peak 190 kW (2027 DC figures said to differ from 2026, but no new figure published).

ac_max_kw.notes: Charge Port: 11.5 kW standard onboard charger, 19.2 kW optional (305 mi range with the standard charger, 300 mi with the optional one); Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW. Powertrain value is the standard charger.
